steps.python:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
out = r'${out}/mcp_client.json'
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join(p for p in sys.path if p))
asset = os.path.normpath(r'${scenario_dir}/../../examples/scenes/go2_float.usda')
profile = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(app.rpc.file))
p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, r'${scenario_dir}/mcp_client.py', profile, str(os.getpid()), asset, out], env=env)
deadline = time.monotonic() + 180.0
while p.poll() is None:
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'the client still runs'
    app.update(True)
assert p.returncode == 0, p.returncode
r = json.load(open(out))
print('MCP', json.dumps(r)[:2000])
tools = ['editor_status', 'editor_launch', 'actions_find', 'action_help', 'action_run', 'actions_batch', 'wait_for', 'document_get', 'scene_tree', 'screenshot', 'console_read', 'action_log', 'python_eval', 'edit_propose', 'proposal_get', 'scenario_run']
assert r['discover'][0] == '2026-07-28' and r['result_type'] == 'complete', r
assert r['tools'] == tools and r['schemas'] and r['legacy_tools'] == tools, r['tools']
assert r['connected'] == os.getpid() and r['legacy_connected'] == os.getpid(), r
assert 'file.import' in r['find'] and {'path', 'mode', 'name'} <= set(r['help_args']), r
assert r['import']['focus'].endswith('go2') and 1 <= r['tree'] < r['tree_all'] and r['dirty'], r
assert r['bad_action']['isError'] and 'no.such_action' in r['bad_action']['text'], r
assert [r['bad_tool'], r['bad_method'], r['bad_version']] == [-32602, -32601, -32022], r
assert r['shot']['rows_ok'] and 0 < r['shot']['width'] <= 400, r
assert r['shot_reported'] == [r['shot']['width'], r['shot']['height']], r
assert '42' in r['eval'] and r['batch'] == [True, False], r
assert r['proposal'] == ['pending', 'pending', '\"go2_agent\"', 1], r['proposal']
assert r['scenario'] == [True, False, [False, False]], r
assert {'nuka://catalog', 'nuka://document'} <= set(r['resources']) and r['catalog'] > 200, r
guides = {'nuka://guide/' + g for g in ('actions', 'connect', 'safety', 'verify', 'workflows')}
assert guides <= set(r['resources']) and r['guide'] == '# Access, proposals and undo', r['resources']
assert r['skill'] == ['SKILL.md', 'references', 0], r['skill']
assert r['exit'] == [0] and r['legacy_version'] == '2025-11-25' and r['legacy_instructions'] and r['ping'], r
deadline = time.monotonic() + 10.0
while app.rpc.sessions():
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline, app.rpc.sessions()
    app.update(True)
sources = {e['source'] for e in app.actions.log(0)}
assert 'agent:mcp' in sources, sources
